# Continental Brand Portal

> > Official brand guidelines and design system for Continental, providing comprehensive resources for logo usage, typography, color systems, and corporate design standards.

This portal serves as the central hub for Continental's brand identity management, featuring the Continental Stag Sans typeface and complete visual identity guidelines. It is the authoritative resource for designers, marketers, and partners working with Continental's brand assets.

## Key Topics

- Continental
- Continental Stag Sans
- Corporate Design
- Brand Guidelines
- Design System
- Logo Usage
- Typography
- Color System
- Brand Identity
- Visual Identity
- Brand Assets
- Design Standards

## Brand Guidelines & Design System

- [Brand Portal - Brandportal](https://brandportal.continental.com/): Continental brand guidelines hub with logo, typography, and design system
